intriguing adj..en: The documentary presents an intriguing question about how cities change over time.
intriguing adj..zh: 這部紀錄片提出一個有趣的問題，探討城市如何隨時間改變。

men n..en: The survey included adult men and women from several different age groups.
men n..zh: 這項調查納入了來自數個不同年齡層的成年男性與女性。

naive adj..en: It would be naive to assume every online claim is automatically reliable.
naive adj..zh: 若認為網路上的每項說法都一定可信，會顯得過於天真。

overnight ad.en: The temperature dropped overnight, leaving a thin layer of frost on the field.
overnight ad.zh: 氣溫在夜間下降，使田地上覆上一層薄霜。

painfully ad.en: The old computer started painfully slowly after several large updates were installed.
painfully ad.zh: 安裝幾個大型更新後，那台舊電腦啟動得慢得令人難受。

pour v..en: Please pour the water slowly so the measuring cup does not overflow.
pour v..zh: 請慢慢倒水，避免量杯溢出。

shorts n..en: He packed light shorts for the warm weather during the school trip.
shorts n..zh: 他為校外旅行的溫暖天氣準備了輕便短褲。

spot..en: We found a quiet spot beside the window for our group discussion.
spot..zh: 我們在窗邊找到一個安靜的位置進行小組討論。

subsequently ad.en: The experiment was repeated and subsequently produced nearly the same result.
subsequently ad.zh: 實驗再次進行後，隨後得到幾乎相同的結果。

sweep n..en: A quick sweep of the classroom found the missing worksheet under a desk.
sweep n..zh: 快速巡查教室後，在一張桌子下找到了遺失的學習單。

swim n..en: We went for a short swim at the supervised pool after practice.
swim n..zh: 練習後，我們在有管理人員的游泳池游了一小段。

tuesday n..en: The science club will meet next tuesday after the final class.
tuesday n..zh: 科學社將在下週二最後一堂課後集合。

i.q..en: The article argues that i.q. alone cannot measure every kind of intelligence.
i.q..zh: 這篇文章主張，單靠智商並不能衡量所有類型的智慧。

aborigine.en: The museum notes that aborigine appears in older sources and may sound dated today.
aborigine.zh: 博物館指出，aborigine 這個詞會出現在較舊的資料中，如今可能顯得過時。

ass.en: In older English, ass can refer to a donkey in traditional stories and proverbs.
ass.zh: 在較舊的英語中，ass 可指驢子，常見於傳統故事與諺語。

bet.en: The lesson explains why a bet always involves uncertainty about the final outcome.
bet.zh: 這堂課說明了為什麼下注總是涉及對最終結果的不確定性。

bleach.en: The safety poster says bleach should remain clearly labeled and stored by adults.
bleach.zh: 安全海報提醒，漂白水應清楚標示並由成人妥善保管。

beer.en: The health lesson discusses beer as an alcoholic drink that minors should avoid.
beer.zh: 健康課討論啤酒屬於酒精飲料，未成年人應避免飲用。

champagne.en: The article mentions champagne while describing traditions at some formal celebrations.
champagne.zh: 這篇文章在介紹某些正式慶典傳統時提到香檳。

cigar.en: The health poster lists cigar smoke among substances that can harm the lungs.
cigar.zh: 健康海報把雪茄煙霧列為可能傷害肺部的物質之一。

cocaine.en: The health class identifies cocaine as an illegal drug with serious health risks.
cocaine.zh: 健康課指出古柯鹼是非法毒品，並具有嚴重健康風險。

coke.en: The history chapter mentions coke as a fuel used in early iron production.
coke.zh: 歷史章節提到焦炭曾被用作早期煉鐵的燃料。

drug.en: The science article uses drug in a medical research context about treating disease.
drug.zh: 這篇科學文章在疾病治療的醫學研究脈絡中使用 drug 這個詞。

drunk.en: The safety campaign warns that a drunk driver can endanger everyone on the road.
drunk.zh: 安全宣導提醒，酒醉駕駛可能危及道路上的所有人。

firecracker.en: The safety notice says a firecracker can cause injuries and should not be handled by children.
firecracker.zh: 安全公告提醒，鞭炮可能造成受傷，兒童不應自行接觸。

gun.en: The museum displays a historic gun behind glass as part of a military exhibit.
gun.zh: 博物館把一把歷史槍械放在玻璃櫃後，作為軍事展覽的一部分。

handsome.en: The charity received a handsome donation that helped repair the community library.
handsome.zh: 這個慈善機構獲得一筆可觀捐款，協助修繕社區圖書館。

lesbian.en: The civics lesson uses lesbian as one term in a discussion of equal rights.
lesbian.zh: 公民課在討論平等權利時使用 lesbian 作為其中一個相關詞彙。

queer.en: The article explains that queer can be an identity term, though context and preference matter.
queer.zh: 這篇文章說明 queer 可作為身分認同用語，但使用時仍應考量語境與個人偏好。

sex.en: The health textbook discusses sex in an age-appropriate section about human development.
sex.zh: 健康課本在適齡的人類發展單元中討論 sex 這個主題。

sexual.en: The health lesson discusses sexual health broadly, including respect and personal boundaries.
sexual.zh: 健康課以廣泛角度討論性健康，包括尊重與個人界線。

slim.en: There is only a slim chance of rain according to the morning forecast.
slim.zh: 根據早晨的天氣預報，降雨機率很低。

slender.en: A slender branch bent gently under the weight of the rain.
slender.zh: 一根細長的樹枝在雨水重量下微微彎曲。

tan.en: The artist chose a tan background to make the dark lettering easier to read.
tan.zh: 藝術家選用棕褐色背景，讓深色文字更容易閱讀。

ugly.en: The debate became ugly when participants stopped listening and began insulting one another.
ugly.zh: 當參與者不再傾聽並開始互相侮辱時，辯論變得難看。

waist.en: The costume has a belt around the waist for historical accuracy.
waist.zh: 這套服裝在腰間繫有腰帶，以符合歷史造型。

thigh.en: The biology diagram labels the thigh as part of the upper leg.
thigh.zh: 生物圖表把大腿標示為腿部上方的一部分。

breast.en: The biology textbook labels the breast as part of human anatomy.
breast.zh: 生物課本把 breast 標示為人體解剖的一部分。

bra.en: The clothing guide lists a bra among common garments worn under other clothes.
bra.zh: 服裝指南把胸罩列為常見的內穿衣物之一。

brassiere.en: The museum catalog uses brassiere as an older formal term for a bra.
brassiere.zh: 博物館目錄使用 brassiere 作為較舊、較正式的胸罩用語。
